subject: Traffic-light MAP: sequencing MSA / DPA / Order Form milestones
messages:
From: Janelle Park <janelle.park@medatlantic.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Aligning on procurement sequencing — can we traffic-light the MAP?

Irene — thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement and legal teams asked for a single, prioritized view that ties the MAP milestones to the specific legal artifacts (MSA / DPA / Order Form) so they can sign off internally.

Key asks:
- Which milestones block purchase order issuance vs. which are pre-go-live only?
- Expected review cycles for MSA and DPA (internal counsel + 3rd-party privacy review)
- Any optional order-form items we can deprioritize to speed signature

Can you share a traffic-light view (green/amber/red) by week for the next 6 weeks and the dependencies between legal and engineering (e.g., SOC evidence, retention settings)?

Janelle Park
Director, Vendor Strategy
MedAtlantic Health

P.S. looping in our procurement alias in case they want to propose a cadence: procurement@medatlantic.com
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Park <janelle.park@medatlantic.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 11:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Aligning on procurement sequencing — can we traffic-light the MAP?

Thanks Janelle — great question. I ran this past Karthik (AE) and Laura (legal); we can absolutely produce a traffic-light MAP that maps each procurement milestone to the specific contractual artifact and internal owner.

High-level approach we propose:
1) Week-by-week traffic-light status for 6 weeks (what must be green to sign)
2) Explicit dependencies: legal review cycles, SOC/attestation delivery, procurement PO window
3) Two parallel tracks: 
   - Contracting (MSA/DPA/order form) — Laura to own redline turnaround estimates
   - Operational gating (SOC2 reports, retention, IAM) — Irene to coordinate with eng for evidence delivery

Action: I will produce the MAP workbook with a milestone column, blocking vs non-blocking flag, and a simple RAG column. Karthik — can you add the commercial milestone dates we discussed? Laura — if you can flag must-have vs optional clauses, we can annotate the order form row.

Irene Choi
Head of Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
(917) 555-0143
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Park <janelle.park@medatlantic.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, MedAtlantic Procurement <procurement@medatlantic.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Proposed traffic-light MAP + milestone timeline (attached)

Janelle / team — attaching the initial MAP_Master.xlsx that follows Irene's layout. Short summary of the traffic-light lanes:

- Week 1 (Aug 21) — Contract kickoff (green): collection of primary POCs, finalize primary term, sign NDA already in place
- Week 2 (Aug 28) — Legal redline pass 1 (amber): we expect a 3-business-day turnaround from MedAtlantic counsel; Laura please confirm
- Week 3 (Sep 4) — Technical evidence delivery (green/amber): SOC2 cert + retention config; Irene to confirm drop-dead dates
- Week 4 (Sep 11) — Order Form finalization (amber): optional add-ons deferred to T+30 to reduce blocker scope
- Week 5 (Sep 18) — Final legal sign-off and countersign (green/red depending on redlines)
- Week 6 (Sep 25) — Expected PO and onboard kickoff (green)

Dependencies noted in the sheet: MSA redline -> DPA scoping -> Order Form pricing; if MSA modifies data-residency or retention terms we consider the Order Form blocked.

Attachments: MAP_Master.xlsx (traffic-light tab + dependencies tab)

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Janelle Park <janelle.park@medatlantic.com>, MedAtlantic Procurement <procurement@medatlantic.com>, Counsel - MedAtlantic <counsel@medatlantic.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Aug 2028 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed traffic-light MAP + milestone timeline (attached)

Karthik / Irene — quick read-through from legal here. I attached a redline PDF (Redwood_MSADPA_v3_redlines.pdf) with our suggested edits and a short comment sheet. High-level legal impact: 

- MSA: we have two commercial clauses that typically add negotiation time (liability cap tied to ARR and indemnity carve-outs). I have flagged these as amber because they usually require exec escalation if MedAtlantic requests material change.
- DPA: data-subprocessing flow is straightforward but we need confirmation on any third-party subprocessors; without that, DPA should be treated as amber.
- Order Form: if MedAtlantic requires custom retention below our standard, that will create a technical gating item and push the timeline to red.

Suggested next steps for cadence:
- Laura to run 1st redline pass and deliver the PDF by EOD Tue (already attached)
- MedAtlantic counsel to respond with markups within 3 business days; if not received, procurement to confirm whether they will accept our standard language for non-blocking items
- Weekly sync: Thursdays 11am ET for the next four weeks (Irene / Karthik / Janelle / counsel)
